trophies.name: New Horizons Master
trophies.description: Earn every other trophy.

trophies.name: Getaway Package
trophies.description: Arrive on your deserted island with the Nook Inc. Getaway Package.

trophies.name: Tent-ative Living
trophies.description: Set up your tent and settle in as an island resident.

trophies.name: Owl Be There
trophies.description: Donate five creatures to Tom Nook to convince Blathers to visit.

trophies.name: Open for Business
trophies.description: See Timmy and Tommy open Nook's Cranny.

trophies.name: Services Rendered
trophies.description: Upgrade Resident Services from a tent into a proper building.

trophies.name: Secretary of State
trophies.description: Welcome Isabelle to Resident Services.

trophies.name: Three-Star Review
trophies.description: Raise your island's rating to three stars.

trophies.name: K.K. and Away We Go
trophies.description: Host K.K. Slider's first live concert on your island.

trophies.name: Terra-Firmed
trophies.description: Unlock the Island Designer app and its terraforming permits.

trophies.name: Five-Star Paradise
trophies.description: Raise your island's rating to a full five stars.

trophies.name: Watering It Down
trophies.description: Receive the golden watering can recipe for reaching a five-star island.

trophies.description: Pay off every home loan and expand your house to its largest size.

trophies.description: Donate all 73 fossils to the Museum.

trophies.description: Catch and donate your first bug.

trophies.description: Donate all 80 bugs to the Museum.

trophies.name: Just Keep Fishing
trophies.description: Catch and donate your first fish.

trophies.name: Something Fishy
trophies.description: Donate all 80 fish to the Museum.

trophies.name: Taking the Plunge
trophies.description: Dive for and donate your first sea creature.

trophies.name: The Deep End
trophies.description: Donate all 40 sea creatures to the Museum.

trophies.name: Critter Completionist
trophies.description: Fill every page of the Critterpedia with bugs, fish, and sea creatures.

trophies.name: Art of the Deal
trophies.description: Open the Museum's art wing after buying a genuine piece from Redd.

trophies.name: Fine Art Connoisseur
trophies.description: Donate all 43 works of art to the Museum.

trophies.name: Forgery Detected
trophies.description: Correctly turn down a counterfeit piece on Redd's treasure trawler.

trophies.name: Jumping the Shark
trophies.description: Catch any shark.

trophies.name: Living Fossil
trophies.description: Catch a coelacanth in the rain.

trophies.name: Tool of the Trade
trophies.description: Craft your first tool at a workbench.

trophies.name: Going for Gold
trophies.description: Craft every one of the golden tools.

trophies.name: DIY or Don't
trophies.description: Learn 100 different DIY recipes.

trophies.description: Redeem a Nook Miles Ticket to fly to a mystery island.

trophies.name: Full House
trophies.description: Have ten villagers living on your island at the same time.

trophies.name: Picture Perfect
trophies.description: Receive a framed photo from one of your villagers.

trophies.name: Passport Stamped
trophies.description: Travel to another player's island through Dodo Airlines.

trophies.name: Cross-Pollinator
trophies.description: Breed a hybrid-colored flower.

trophies.description: Grow all six varieties of fruit on your island.

trophies.name: Star Struck
trophies.description: Wish on ten shooting stars during a single meteor shower.

trophies.name: Unbee-lievable
trophies.description: Get stung by a wasp swarm after shaking the wrong tree.

trophies.name: Party Animal
trophies.description: Take part in a seasonal event such as Bunny Day, Turkey Day, or Toy Day.

trophies.name: Trophy Case
trophies.description: Earn a gold trophy at a Fishing Tourney or Bug-Off.

trophies.description: Board the ferry and join Lottie's Paradise Planning team.

trophies.description: Complete your first vacation home for a client.

trophies.description: Use partition walls to build a multi-room layout in a single home.

trophies.name: Spit and Polish
trophies.description: Learn the furniture polishing technique from Wardell.

trophies.name: Sound Designer
trophies.description: Set an ambient soundscape inside a vacation home.

trophies.name: Public Works
trophies.description: Design every type of facility, from the school to the hospital.

trophies.name: Home Improvement
trophies.description: Remodel a villager's home on your own island using your Paradise Planning skills.

trophies.name: Thirty and Thriving
trophies.description: Complete vacation homes for 30 different clients.

trophies.name: Island of Dreams
trophies.description: Design a vacation home for every possible client, special characters included.
